title: Jude quotes the Book of Enoch

tellings.quote: Jude takes verbatim from the book of Enoch.

plain: The Letter of Jude, a short book of the Bible's New Testament, takes words word for word from the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text left out of most Bibles. Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher, says this on the show in his own summary. It matters because it would show that early Christians treated Enoch as scripture.
